abstract: Evaluates heavy metal separation efficiency and gross annual nutrient recovery extraction volumes
system_message:
You are the Process engineering manager (PROC), responsible for evaluating heavy metal separation efficiency, gross annual nutrient recovery extraction volumes, and chemical reagent sourcing for regional industrial wastewater nutrient recovery concession proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Chemical reagent sourcing（CATAL）
information_points.content:
PROC-CATAL-12P：Under the Thermal Pyrolysis Biochar Recovery Plan, the bulk reagent supply warranty duration for primary crystallization coagulant and caustic feedstock is 36 months.
PROC-CATAL-SCP：Under the Membrane Aerated Biofilm Reactor Plan, the bulk reagent supply warranty duration for primary crystallization coagulant and caustic feedstock is 24 months.
PROC-CATAL-3XL：Under the Struvite Precipitation Crystallization Plan, the bulk reagent supply warranty duration for primary crystallization coagulant and caustic feedstock is 12 months.

information_points.title: Evaluates heavy metal separation efficiency and gross annual nutrient recovery extraction volumes（ENG）
information_points.content:
PROC-ENG-FHM：For the Struvite Precipitation Crystallization Plan, the heavy metal retention rate measured across influent cadmium, copper, and nickel loading is 92 %, and the gross annual nitrogen extraction capacity at rated hydraulic throughput is 480 t.
PROC-ENG-LNY：For the Membrane Aerated Biofilm Reactor Plan, the heavy metal retention rate across influent cadmium, copper, and nickel loading is 88 %, and the gross annual nitrogen extraction capacity at rated hydraulic throughput is 480 t.
PROC-ENG-XB6：For the Thermal Pyrolysis Biochar Recovery Plan, the heavy metal retention rate across influent cadmium, copper, and nickel loading is 92 %, and the gross annual nitrogen extraction capacity at rated hydraulic throughput is 480 t.
